title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-01-03
source: BD > MR > DAT > C > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard recording of a smoky 1970 show, highlighted by a monster 'The Other One' and an electrifying Black Peter.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the energetic performance, calling it one of their favorite versions of The Other One and praising the fiery Black Peter where Jerry even takes lead vocals. The SBD source is noted as a clear improvement over earlier copies, delivering good‑to‑excellent sound throughout the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the improved soundboard quality push the overall rating into the top tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Improved sound quality over previous copies; clear, balanced SBD capture with no major issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a high‑energy, jam‑filled performance typical of early 1970, noting powerful moments and seamless flow especially around The Other One and Black Peter.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for taking vocal lead on Black Peter and delivering strong overall performance.
